hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: A robust five-session state of elevated average reported dollar per transaction, sustained participation and nonnegative tape, explicitly excluding every recent single-day z>=3 block outlier, may identify incomplete price discovery that persists through H5 relative to zero-return cash and identical-clock costed SPY and QQQ, while unsigned daily aggregates do not identify institutional accumulation.
causal_components: at least four of five ADTS observations above preceding-126 median
latest-five median ADTS at or above preceding-126 q90
latest-five median dollar participation no lower than max USD1m and prior-20 median
maximum recent dynamic prior-126 z below 3
maximum three simultaneous USD4000 research positions under USD12000 cash reservation
next-session entry and H5 exit existence
nonnegative five-session tape and USD3 minimum close
research-only observed-only ceiling with trade disabled
top-two daily ranking with ten-session ticker cooldown
zero-return cash plus same-clock costed SPY and QQQ replacement comparators
acceptance_rule: Ceiling observed_only regardless of sign (research_pit sources). Frozen falsifier: the fixed 183-row roster must keep at least five executable treatment touches in every standard window (33/75/75 as frozen); treatment net value after 35bp total round-trip cost must be positive versus zero-return cash AND exceed both same-clock 35bp-costed SPY and QQQ in aggregate; at least two of three windows positive versus cash; treatment must remain positive versus cash under 70bp total cost; maximum ticker selection share <= 15 percent; maximum concurrent positions <= 3; every missing execution input fails closed and any endpoint/identity/coverage/clock contract failure invalidates the run. No retune after outcome access.

prediction.confidence_reason: The mechanism is economically distinct and densely executable, but literature counterevidence, absent sign or participant identity and research-PIT vintage uncertainty warrant a low prior and an observed-only ceiling.

calibration.surprise_note: Reservation deadlocked by tooling, not by evidence; no calibration signal.
